theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M S B : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (θ ψ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (c K : ℝ), MeasurableSet B → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → AEMeasurable θ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict M) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((M ∩ B) \ S) = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (S ∩ B) ≠ ⊤ → Measurable ψ → (∀ w, |ψ w| ≤ K) → (∀ w, w ∉ B → ψ w = 0) → ∫⁻ w in S ∩ B, ‖M.indicator θ w - c‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ≠ ⊤ → |∫ w in M, ψ w * θ w ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) - c * ∫ w in S, ψ w ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))| ≤ K * (∫⁻ w in S ∩ B, ‖M.indicator θ w - c‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))).toReal
